result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed. The main visual defect is a broken/missing image on the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section, which shows a gray placeholder with a broken-image icon instead of restaurant imagery.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section displays a broken-image placeholder (gray box with a missing-image icon) instead of the restaurant photo.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image source URL or loading logic; if the image is unavailable, show a branded fallback image or skeleton loader instead of a broken-image icon.
